abstract: Assesses regional transit arterial connectivity, evacuation route clearances, and paratransit access
system_message:
You are Emergency Transportation Coordinator (TRANS). The Emergency Transportation Coordinator (TRANS) evaluates regional transit arterial connectivity, evacuation route clearances, and paratransit access, alongside external bus staging capacity for prospective emergency shelter facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evacuation bus staging（PARK）
information_points.content:
TRANS-PARK-6KU：According to the transit staging survey of the facility exterior bus terminal, the Santa Rosa Veterans Memorial Auditorium provides 12 bays dedicated for 60-foot articulated bus staging and boarding.
TRANS-PARK-ZQK：According to the transit staging survey of the facility exterior bus terminal, the Petaluma Community Recreation Complex provides 6 bays dedicated for 60-foot articulated bus staging and boarding.
TRANS-PARK-AYX：According to the transit staging survey of the facility exterior bus terminal, the Sonoma County Fairgrounds Pavilion provides 18 bays dedicated for 60-foot articulated bus staging and boarding.

information_points.title: Assesses regional transit arterial connectivity, evacuation route clearances, and paratransit access（ROADS）
information_points.content:
TRANS-ROADS-O0F：For the Sonoma County Fairgrounds Pavilion, the regional transit authority route evaluation confirms that multi-modal transit route accessibility is true, as primary heavy bus transit routes along access arterial highways connecting primary evacuation zones to the facility remain unencumbered by secondary road closures or bridge weight restrictions.
TRANS-ROADS-9VO：For the Santa Rosa Veterans Memorial Auditorium, the regional transit authority route evaluation confirms that multi-modal transit route accessibility is true, with primary heavy bus transit routes along access arterial highways connecting primary evacuation zones to the facility remaining unencumbered by secondary road closures or bridge weight restrictions.
TRANS-ROADS-LK3：For the Petaluma Community Recreation Complex, the regional transit authority route evaluation indicates that multi-modal transit route accessibility is false, as primary heavy bus transit routes along access arterial highways connecting primary evacuation zones to the facility do not remain unencumbered by secondary road closures or bridge weight restrictions.
